name: infiniterm
title: infiniterm
description: Open Finder folders in infiniterm, in a workspace you pick or a new one.
author: tarik

commands.name: open-in-infiniterm
commands.title: Open in infiniterm
commands.subtitle: infiniterm
commands.description: Open the Finder selection (or the front Finder window) in a workspace you choose, or a new one.

commands.name: new-terminal-card
commands.title: New Terminal Card
commands.subtitle: infiniterm

commands.title: Open in infiniterm (Current Workspace)
